text:
sarah.ae: Quick heads-up — Board has paused the Acme POC until we provide a written data-residency attestation + a fixed trial pricing cap. They want an exec-level sign-off (CISO/CTO) before the legal PO moves. Can someone from Eng/Security join a 30m call today?

alan.presales: I can join. Do we have a short templated attestation we can use, or does Legal want bespoke wording? Also, pricing cap — are we talking list or discounted pilot tiers? :thinking_face:

priya.sec: We can produce a one-page attestation (data stays in customer VPC/region, no egress without approval, audit logs retained 90 days). Need to confirm KMS model (BYOK vs Redwood KMS) and whether they require on-prem. If they insist on on-prem we'll need SOC2 + network runbook.

mike.eng: For Dedicated/VPC we can spin a pilot cluster in ~4 business days. On-prem would add 3-4 weeks depending on hardware.

chris.csm: FYI customer asked for cost guarantees for the 6-week trial window. They want a hard ceiling per 1M tokens. Can Finance give a committed pilot price we can present? I can marshal exec sponsor intro if we have the doc. :+1:

alan.presales: Proposal draft: 6-week Dedicated pilot, isolated VPC, BYOK optional, trial price cap $2,500 flat/week or $0.00075/token on overage (whichever is lower). Need confirm from Rev. Can we share that as a starting point?

priya.sec: That pricing cap is fine to present as a proposal. For the attestation text, draft below — legal review needed.

priya.sec: ```
Data Residency Attestation (draft)
- Customer data processed only in region: eu-west-1.
- No external egress of raw data without customer's written approval.
- All keys may be customer-managed (BYOK) or Redwood-managed with HSM.
- Audit logs for inference requests retained for 90 days.
```

sarah.ae: Perfect — leaning on Legal for final wording. @ops-bot please open an internal ticket to track approvers and owners.

ops-bot: Created ticket SD-1729 (BoardApproval: Acme POC). Assigned: alan.presales, priya.sec, legal-team.

mike.eng: Quick note on risks: if they require model pinning + quantized variant we'll need a small compatibility test. Recommend we run a 1-hour validation with their sample corpus before the exec call. Who can provide samples?

chris.csm: I have a sanitized sample set from the customer. Will drop into the secure share now and invite Eng.

alan.presales: Can someone from Finance/Rev confirm we can hold to the $2,500/week cap for the 6-week pilot? If not, what's the alternative? @finance-ops?

sarah.ae: If Finance signs off, plan: 1) Send draft attestation + pricing to customer today, 2) Schedule 30m with CISO/CTO + our exec (Alan+Priya) tomorrow, 3) Kick off infra validation once samples are in. Target: board sign-off by EOD Fri.

priya.sec: Legal asked for the following addendum: "Redwood to provide SOC2 report and completed security questionnaire within 48h of request." Get legal eyes on that and we'll prep.

mike.eng: I'll reserve a staging Dedicated cluster slot for the pilot (no config changes until we get green). If we need BYOK onboarding, please start the KMS paperwork — that can take 24-48h.

chris.csm: I'll coordinate exec intro + calendar. If anyone can join a 2pm slot tomorrow that's ideal for their execs.

alan.presales: I'm free 2pm. priya.sec?

priya.sec: 2pm works. Sarah, can you confirm and send meeting invite with draft doc attached?

sarah.ae: On it. Draft going to Legal for sign-off now, will ping when ready. Thanks all — let's try to keep this tight, board said "no paper trail, no POC." :eyes:

ops-bot: SD-1729 status updated -> "awaiting legal review"

alan.presales: If we get the board sign-off, next ask from their procurement may be a short-term SLA (uptime + response). I'll prepare a simple SLA addendum to attach to the pilot.

priya.sec: One last ask — please confirm whether customer requires physical air-gapped on-prem. If not, we keep this within Dedicated/VPC and it's much faster.

chris.csm: Customer clarified in DM: on-prem only if regulatory audit demands; otherwise VPC deployment is acceptable for the pilot. I'll update them with our draft and schedule. :thumbsup:

sarah.ae: Closing loop — legal review in progress. Will post back here when I have the signed attestation or if we need an exec intro immediately. Thanks team."
